mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit_event_inbox WHERE event_id = #{eventId, jdbcType=OTHER})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_events (id, event_id, tenant_id, aggregate_id, event_type, trace_id, payload, occurred_at) VALUES (#{id, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{eventId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{tenantId}, #{aggregateId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{eventType}, #{traceId}, CAST(#{payload} AS JSONB), #{occurredAt})
INSERT INTO audit_event_inbox (event_id, tenant_id, aggregate_id) VALUES (#{eventId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{tenantId}, #{aggregateId, jdbcType=OTHER})
